title: Measuring Social Biases in Masked Language Models by Proxy of Prediction Quality
reasoning: The paper explicitly includes 'Religion' as one of the key social bias categories it benchmarks and evaluates. It uses the Crowdsourced Stereotype Pairs Benchmark (CPS) and StereoSet, both of which contain religion-specific subsets, and the paper reports specific bias scores and analysis for religious biases in the results and appendices.
